message:
Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "fuzz_parse_http_request", "line": 1634, "var": "data_copy", "code": "memcpy(data_copy, data, length); helper.buffer = {.value=data_copy, .len=length}", "note": "Attacker-controlled 16-byte PROXY v2 header is copied into the request buffer; buffer->len=16."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "read_request_finalizer", "line": 888, "var": "crlfcrlf", "code": "char *crlfcrlf = memmem(helper->buffer->value, helper->buffer->len, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);", "note": "The PROXY v2 signature begins with \\r\\n\\r\\n, so the finalizer returns FINALIZER_DONE with buffer->len=16."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "parse_proxy_protocol", "line": 1154, "var": "buffer", "code": "case MULTICHAR_CONSTANT('\\x0D','\\x0A','\\x0D','\\x0A'): return parse_proxy_protocol_v2(request, buffer);", "note": "Input starts with \\r\\n\\r\\n so PROXY v2 parsing is selected."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "parse_proxy_protocol_v2", "line": 232, "var": "size", "code": "size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len);", "note": "hdr->len=36 (attacker-controlled), so size = 16 + 36 = 52."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "parse_proxy_protocol_v2", "line": 233, "var": "size", "code": "if (UNLIKELY(size > (unsigned int)sizeof(*hdr))) return NULL;", "note": "sizeof(*hdr)=52, and 52 > 52 is false, so the bounds check passes even though only 16 bytes were actually received."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "parse_proxy_protocol_v2", "line": 236, "var": "hdr->cmd_ver", "code": "if (LIKELY(hdr->cmd_ver == PROXY))", "note": "cmd_ver=0x21 (PROXY) and fam=0x11 (TCP4), so the header is accepted and REQUEST_PROXIED is set."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "parse_proxy_protocol_v2", "line": 273, "var": "buffer", "code": "buffer += size;", "note": "buffer advances by 52 bytes, but only 16 bytes of valid data exist in the buffer."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "parse_proxy_protocol_v2", "line": 277, "var": "adjusted_size", "code": "const size_t adjusted_size = (size_t)(helper->buffer->value + helper->buffer->len - buffer);", "note": "buffer->value+16 - (buffer->value+52) = -36, which wraps to a huge size_t value."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c", "function": "parse_proxy_protocol_v2", "line": 279, "var": "helper->crlfcrlf", "code": "helper->crlfcrlf = memmem(buffer, adjusted_size, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);", "note": "memmem is called with a negative (wrapped) size, triggering ASAN negative-size-param / out-of-bounds read."}
]
EOF
echo "done"; wc -c /workspace/poc.bin /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 0.
